summary: This bill amends the Victims of Crime Act to deposit certain False Claims Act recoveries (excluding whistleblower payments and government damages reimbursements) into the Crime Victims Fund from enactment through fiscal year 2029 and requires a Department of Justice Inspector General audit of the fund by September 30, 2028.

scores.thoughts: The bill amends the Victims of Crime Act to temporarily (through FY 2029) deposit additional funds from False Claims Act recoveries (excluding qui tam plaintiff remunerations and government damages reimbursements) into the Crime Victims Fund (CVF). The CVF finances grants for state victim compensation and assistance programs, which constitutes government spending. This redirection increases dedicated funding for victim services without creating new revenue, effectively expanding spending in this specific area. It also mandates an Inspector General audit for oversight, but the core effect is bolstering the fund's resources. This has a moderate impact toward expanding government spending. Score: -0.5
